Archive ledger

Sixty bundles from the trustees' index, listed in catalogue order. The full ledger runs to several thousand entries; this is the portion transcribed so far.

  1. Item 001

    Catalogued in 1848, this bundle holds the borough surveyor's report on Hollow Lane, filed under the map store and cross-referenced to the trustees' index. The paper is sound, the ink has faded unevenly along the fold, and a pencilled hand has added a note in the margin that the conservation team has chosen not to remove. Consultation is by appointment. Entry 001 of the ledger.
